title: Big Hero 6 The Series
description: Picking up immediately following the events in the feature film, these are the continuing adventures and friendship of 14-year-old tech genius Hiro and his compassionate, cutting-edge robot Baymax. As the new prodigy at San Fransokyo Institute of Technology, Hiro now faces daunting academic challenges and the social trials of being the little man on campus. Off campus, the stakes are raised for the high-tech heroes as they must protect their city from an array of scientifically enhanced villains.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 1x1
episodes_data.description: Hiro thinks Baymax is lost forever, until he finds the chip that Tadashi designed to create Baymax. Hiro immediately gets to work rebuilding his friend.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 1x2
episodes_data.description: As Hiro tries to find a way to connect to classmate Karmi, Go Go and Fred dive deep into comic book mythology to defeat High Voltage, a mother-daughter supervillain duo.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 1x3
episodes_data.description: Go Go and Honey Lemon quickly clash when they become roommates. Meanwhile, when a thief steals Honey Lemon’s chem-lab purse, it accidentally turns him into a monster.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 1x4
episodes_data.description: When supervillain Baron Von Steamer crashes Fred’s Bro-Tillion, the Big Hero 6 team springs into action.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 1x5
episodes_data.description: When Aunt Cass stumbles into an underground cooking competition, she thrives and becomes addicted to the excitement.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 1x6
episodes_data.description: Hiro, Fred, and Baymax follow GoGo into the mysterious Muirahara Woods where they get lost and everything electronic strangely fails including Baymax.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 1x7
episodes_data.description: Hiro becomes demoralized when his latest school project fails spectacularly; the team must take on the incompetent villain, Globby.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 1x8
episodes_data.description: After Aunt Cass nearly discovers Hiro's secret membership in the Big Hero 6, Hiro tries to set her up with someone to distract her.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 1x9
episodes_data.description: Although he is obviously ill, Hiro refuses to listen to his team-mates and Baymax and only watch from afar as they fight the mercenary team Mad Jacks.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 1x10
episodes_data.description: Crazy game show host Mr. Sparkles threatens to hurt Hiro's cat Mochi to force Go Go to join a game. But she is very afraid of public appearances.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 1x11
episodes_data.description: Wasabi's need for order clashes with Hiro's chaotic work style when they collaborate on a school project.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 1x12
episodes_data.description: Hiro becomes frustrated when he's deemed too young to attend a science workshop hosted by SFIT's most famous alumni, Dr. Trevor Trengrove.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 1x13
episodes_data.description: Hiro decides to upgrade himself with super strength.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 1x14
episodes_data.description: Honey Lemon takes art classes at a rival school.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 1x15
episodes_data.description: Karmi posts Big Hero 6 fan fiction, embarrassing Hiro.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 1x16
episodes_data.description: Hiro invents a tiny robot, Mini-Max, to supervise and be a sidekick to Fred while the rest of the team is in class.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 1x17
episodes_data.description: Richardson Mole blackmails his way into Big Hero 6.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 1x18
episodes_data.description: When a monster wreaks havoc in San Fransokyo, Big Hero 6 must go on a real-life monster hunt.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 1x19
episodes_data.description: Hiro and the others plan the ultimate birthday surprise for Wasabi by recovering his car from the bottom of the bay, but Baron Von Steamer ruins the celebration.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 1x20
episodes_data.description: To try to prove Yama is behind a mysterious crime spree, perpetrated by tiny bots, Hiro is drawn back into the illegal world of bot-fighting.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 1x21
episodes_data.description: After the gang goes to a spooky haunted house, Hiro keeps seeing Tadashi around the city and ultimately finds himself face to face with his brother.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 1x22
episodes_data.description: Big Hero 6 face their greatest challenge as Obake unleashes his plan on San Fransokyo.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 2x1
episodes_data.description: Hiro’s jealousy of Karmi’s internship at Sycorax leads him to intern at Krei Tech.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 2x2
episodes_data.description: Professor Granville becomes increasingly pushy with Big Hero 6 as she helps them figure out a mysterious series of food-related burglaries.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 2x3
episodes_data.description: Hiro and Fred enlist Karmi to find out what happened to Orso Knox, the man who was mysteriously turned into a monster.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 2x4
episodes_data.description: When Aunt Cass sets Hiro up on a date, he begins to wonder if he’s missing out on being a regular kid.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 2x5
episodes_data.description: Honey Lemon sets out to make Globby human again.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 2x6
episodes_data.description: Big Hero 6 must stop a secret underground racing league.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 2x7
episodes_data.description: When Hiro and Go Go accompany Krei to the woods to deal with Nedd Ludd, they run into The Hibagon, a legendary monster.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 2x8
episodes_data.description: Mayoi, mysterious yet adorable creatures, begin to appear in San Fransokyo.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 2x9
episodes_data.description: Big Hero 6 attempts to thwart a bank robbery and encounter Supersonic Sue, an old school roller skating villain.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 2x10
episodes_data.description: Upon discovering Baymax’s ability to detect if a person is lying, Hiro attempts to use him to uncover proof of deceit.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 2x11
episodes_data.description: Karmi and Hiro team up to help treat someone with genetically engineered parasites.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 2x12
episodes_data.description: Karmi and Hiro team up to help treat someone with genetically engineered parasites.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 2x13
episodes_data.description: Big Hero 6 must continue to fight off a city overrun with monsters.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 2x14
episodes_data.description: When Fred runs into a string of bad luck, Megan reveals to Hiro that she’s trying to uncover the true identities of Big Hero 6 for her school’s newspaper.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 2x15
episodes_data.description: Professional mech-wrestler El Fuego is intent on becoming the toughest fighter in San Fransokyo and decides he must beat the strongest challenger he can find, Baymax.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 2x16
episodes_data.description: Nega-Globby takes control of Globby’s body to cause chaos around the city.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 2x17
episodes_data.description: Evil villain Hardlight challenges the Big Hero 6 team to a real-life video game duel.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 2x18
episodes_data.description: When Hiro finds a wrapped present in the closet, he assumes it's from Aunt Cass and takes it in order to figure out what it is. However, after a mix-up, the present becomes lost and Hiro enlists the Big Hero 6 team to track it down.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 2x19
episodes_data.description: Momakase blackmails Hiro into helping her steal her family's knives from Yama's safe.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 2x20
episodes_data.description: Megan confronts Hiro about being a vigilante and threatens to tell Chief Cruz the truth.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 2x21
episodes_data.description: Fred's invisibility function on his suit glitches during patrol.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 2x22
episodes_data.description: A new villain, Major Blast, appears in the city and targets Fred.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 2x23
episodes_data.description: Supersonic Stu busts his grandmother, Supersonic Sue, out of prison.

episodes_data.title: Big Hero 6 The Series 2x24
episodes_data.description: Chief Cruz and the police get the upper hand in their battle with both villains and Big Hero 6 when they begin using Buddy Guardians, powerful new robots produced by Krei Tech.
